MERGE INTO REP_INVEST_ACCOUNT RIA USING ( SELECT #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} PROD_ID, #{accountType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ACCOUNT_TYPE, #{accountNum,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ACCOUNT_NUM, #{accountName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ACCOUNT_NAME, #{accountOpener,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ACCOUNT_OPENER, #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} STATUS, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_USER, #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} CREATE_TIME, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_DEPT, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UPDATE_USER, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} UPDATE_TIME FROM DUAL ) TEMP
ON(RIA.PROD_ID = TEMP.PROD_ID )
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET RIA.ACCOUNT_TYPE = TEMP.ACCOUNT_TYPE, RIA.ACCOUNT_NUM = TEMP.ACCOUNT_NUM, RIA.ACCOUNT_NAME = TEMP.ACCOUNT_NAME, RIA.ACCOUNT_OPENER = TEMP.ACCOUNT_OPENER, RIA.CREATE_TIME = TEMP.CREATE_TIME, RIA.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, RIA.CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, RIA.CREATE_USER = TEMP.CREATE_USER, RIA.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, RIA.STATUS = TEMP.STATUS
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (PROD_ID,ACCOUNT_TYPE,ACCOUNT_NUM, ACCOUNT_NAME,ACCOUNT_OPENER,STATUS, CREATE_USER,CREATE_TIME,CREATE_DEPT, UPDATE_USER,UPDATE_TIME) VALUES( TEMP.PROD_ID,TEMP.ACCOUNT_TYPE,TEMP.ACCOUNT_NUM, TEMP.ACCOUNT_NAME,TEMP.ACCOUNT_OPENER,TEMP.STATUS, TEMP.CREATE_USER,TEMP.CREATE_TIME,TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, TEMP.UPDATE_USER,TEMP.UPDATE_TIME)
